_what: Every VGC World Championship pokedata publishes. A Worlds is played once under one regulation and then frozen, so these are HISTORY - what the field played that August - never current usage.
_divisions: Masters, Seniors and Juniors are three separate metagames off the same roster. Never pool them.
_counted: Per TEAM, not per appearance: the Species Clause means a team holds a species at most once.

_years_note: One entry per year, merged across that year's events. 2023 is the case that forces this: its Masters teamlists are on the Day 1 event (tid 0000089) and its Seniors and Juniors on the Day 2 one (tid 0000083), so either alone loses a division. `from` records which event each division was taken from. 2022 has no teamlists on any day or division - standings only, upstream.
